records.title: Repo2Skill-Evo: Repository Skills Go Stale in Silence

records.title: ToSCA: Leveraging Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning on Temporal and Strategic Abstractions of Conversational Agents
records.reason: ToSCA is reinforcement-learning training for conversational agents; training-only work is outside scope.

records.title: Semantic Reasoning Denoising: Correcting Language Model Reasoning with Semantic Operators
records.reason: Semantic Reasoning Denoising trains a model to improve reasoning quality through repeated inference-time denoising; the abstract reports accuracy, not reduced inference compute, latency, memory, or serving cost.

records.title: TANGO: Treating Tokens as Operators
records.reason: Primary full text §§3–5 and §6.1. The throughput results (3.26–3.45× against full TANGO) are training/model-evaluation experiments over FineWeb-Edu; the paper states that generation is largely untested.

records.title: Learning When Not to Listen: Selective Anti-Interference Pretraining for Language Models
records.reason: This is selective anti-interference pretraining, a training-time method excluded by the project scope.
